items.title: 12.11 Particles ke masses ke darmiyan forces ki theories (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11 (PDF 275-276) in the book's order, with a tip and a self-check.

blocks.text: Particles ke masses ke darmiyan alag alag mediators (beech mein kaam karne wale particles) ke zariye interactions samjhane ke liye do theories hain: quantum field theory aur string theory.
